## Accuracy and provenance limitations

Existing batch3 accuracy audit reports bit-exact original-evaluator repeats but ERROR_UNBOUNDED. AP cache serialization lacks the per-precision fallback observable/residual records needed for a source-specific total-K enclosure. Fixed-order GH8 equivalence and repeats are software/reproducibility evidence, not quadrature or entropy error bounds. GH convergence records for other ensembles/channels cannot resolve these gaps. Phase2A/overnight records and latest final_verification.json likewise certify no total-K error bound. Consequently no reported pairwise gap, including3.6726688357191506e-10, is a rigorously or statistically resolved ordering under these records. epsilon_opt=1e-8 is an objective stopping tolerance, never a numerical-error bound. Threshold membership describes literal stored differences only.
